conviction_note: Nothing here is unpriced. The Q3 revenue drivers (Main Market equity turnover of 171.5 bn PLN, about +49% y/y, and TGE volumes) were published month by month, the cost path was guided qualitatively on 4 Sep, and the last two beats moved the stock -0.5% and 0.0% on the day. So p_up sits at 51 and the scaled number is about zero. abs_move_pct is held at 3% from 40% realised vol and the European base for a release whose drivers are already public.

new_in_release.expect: Net profit probably around Q2's 58.7m PLN or slightly above it, and well above Q3 2025's 49.2m. Revenue drivers flat to up q/q, costs up about 11% or more y/y as guided. A small beat on an unsourced bar is the most likely outcome, but the inputs are public.
Q4/2027 cost commentary, mainly the size of the WATS depreciation step-up. Unknown, with a slight negative risk if it is quantified above what analysts carry.
October and November activity under WATS: October was +35.6% y/y and public. Mildly positive and largely known.
No interim dividend was found. The strategy allows payouts more than once a year, but nothing indicates one now. Unknown.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 Main Market equity turnover was 171.5 bn PLN (58.1 + 51.9 + 61.5), about +49% y/y against roughly 115 bn in Q3 2025, an acceleration from H1's +27.4% y/y, which lifted H1 financial-market revenue 23%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 2026 beat (net 58.7m against a 54.4m consensus) was followed by -0.48% on 4 Sep 2026 and a drift lower. The Q3 2025 beat (49.2m against 46.3m) was followed by 0.0% on 17 Nov 2025 and -1.27% the next day (Yahoo GPW.WA bars).
findings.original_quote: Łączna wartość obrotu akcjami na Głównym Rynku GPW we wrześniu 2026 r. wyniosła 61,5 mld zł, co oznacza wzrost rdr o 60,1 proc. (Total Main Market share turnover in September 2026 was 61.5 bn PLN, +60.1% y/y.)
findings.why_not_priced: It largely is priced. Monthly turnover is published by the issuer, and the sell side (6 analysts) models fees from it. If it were unpriced, a consensus below Q2's 58.7m would be visible despite higher Q3 turnover. No consensus was found, so the residual is only the fee-tiering elasticity and the timing of cost recognition.

findings.finding: The CEO guided that Q3 2026 cost growth would be no lower than H1's +11.0% y/y and that Q4 cost growth rises further with WATS depreciation, so the release's Q4/2027 cost commentary is the line most likely to disappoint.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The guidance was given at the H1 release (4 Sep 2026). The stock fell -0.48% that day and drifted from 93.85 to 88.85 by 14 Sep, though how much of that was the cost guide cannot be separated.
findings.original_quote: dynamika kosztów będzie na poziomie nie niższym niż w pierwszej połowie roku ... ze sprawą m.in. wzrostu amortyzacji związanej z wdrożeniem WATS (cost growth will be no lower than in the first half ... due among other things to higher depreciation linked to the WATS rollout)
findings.why_not_priced: Q3 costs land inside what was guided, so that part is priced. Only a quantification of the Q4/2027 WATS depreciation step above what analysts carry would be new, and its size is unknown.

findings.finding: TGE gas volume fell sharply (September 8.2 TWh, -34.6% y/y) while electricity rose (+49.4% y/y in September, +35% in August). That follows a Q2 in which TGE revenue fell 7.3% y/y on weaker gas, so the commodity segment, about 28% of group revenue, is likely flat to soft y/y.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2's TGE revenue decline was disclosed inside a beat and the stock fell -0.48% on the day, so the line was not separately priced.
findings.original_quote: Obrót gazem ziemnym wyniósł 8,2 TWh i był o 34,6 proc. niższy niż rok wcześniej (Natural gas turnover was 8.2 TWh, 34.6% lower than a year earlier), per the search snippet.
findings.why_not_priced: Public monthly TGE statistics, so largely priced. Net of the rest of the company, the financial-market segment's turnover surge outweighs it.

language_note: Every load-bearing datum came from Polish sources: the monthly Main Market turnover releases (Strefa Inwestorów, bank.pl), the CEO's Q3/Q4 cost-dynamics guidance quoted by XYZ on 4 Sep, the TGE volume reports (gramwzielone), and the 2 Nov sell-off explanation (XYZ, DM BOŚ analyst on Constitutional Tribunal risk).

lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the monthly turnover finding went from +0.4 to +0.2 and the October trading finding from +0.2 to +0.1, both being issuer-published numbers.
Inside-guidance rule (core table): the cost finding went from -0.3 to -0.2, because Q3 costs land inside the CEO's 4 Sep guide; only Q4 quantification is new.
TGE finding went from -0.1 to -0.05 (public monthly statistics, a segment net of the rest of the company).

p_up went from 52 to 51 (verified fact is not a predicted reaction; the last two beats moved 0 to -0.5%). abs_move_pct kept at 3.0 rather than cut to the name's small history ('let the reaction history move p_up, not abs_move_pct').
